basic_details.job_title: CGA Senior Accounts Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Ministry of External Affairs has proposed deploying two Sr. Accounts Officers on deputation basis in its Summits Division, New Delhi, for two years with effect from December 2026. The Controller General of Accounts of India (Department of Expenditure, Ministry of Finance) circulated this on 16 November 2026. Willing and eligible Sr. AOs must forward applications with a Vigilance Clearance Certificate/Integrity Certificate to the CGA office positively by 30 November 2026.

vacancy_details.Organisation: Summits Division, Ministry of External Affairs, New Delhi

post_wise_breakdown.organisation: Summits Division, Ministry of External Affairs, New Delhi

how_to_apply: Willing and eligible Sr. AOs forward their applications to the Controller General of Accounts, HR-2 Section, Mahalekha Niyantrak Bhawan, GPO Complex, INA, New Delhi.
Enclose the Vigilance Clearance Certificate/Integrity Certificate with the application.
Comply with the checklist prescribed in the CGA O.M. dated 02.03.2026.
Make sure the application reaches the CGA office positively by 30 November 2026.
important_instructions: The Ministry of External Affairs made the proposal in its letter No. CCS/494/MISC/2026 dated 29.10.2026. The checklist in the CGA O.M. dated 02.03.2026 "may also be complied with" while forwarding applications. The Vigilance Clearance Certificate/Integrity Certificate is required with the application.

content_sections.heading: About CGA
content_sections.text: The Controller General of Accounts of India works under the Department of Expenditure, Ministry of Finance, Government of India. Its HR-2 Section issued this circular from Mahalekha Niyantrak Bhawan, GPO Complex, INA, New Delhi. The posts are in the Summits Division of the Ministry of External Affairs, New Delhi.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The circular lists one requirement, for two posts in total.

rows.organisation: Summits Division, Ministry of External Affairs, New Delhi

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The circular invites "willing and eligible Sr. AOs". It does not print any educational qualification, experience requirement or age limit. Applications must come with a Vigilance Clearance Certificate/Integrity Certificate. Candidates should check the official circular for further eligibility details.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The posts are on deputation basis for a period of two years w.e.f. December 2026. The circular does not state the pay or any allowances.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CGA Sr. Accounts Officer
content_sections.text: Willing and eligible Sr. AOs forward their applications to the Controller General of Accounts, HR-2 Section, Mahalekha Niyantrak Bhawan, GPO Complex, INA, New Delhi. Enclose the Vigilance Clearance Certificate/Integrity Certificate with the application. Comply with the checklist prescribed in the CGA O.M. dated 02.03.2026. Make sure the application reaches the CGA office positively by 30 November 2026.
